{"id": "4f708601-0dd1-4a88-99d4-e3b6ed1c4507", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "All the recommendation calls are returning empty, and the utilization API confirms there's no Savings Plans data since none have been purchased—consistent with the access-denied error on the describe call being just a permissions gap rather than hidden data.
